| Method | Path | Handler | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|---------|

| POST | `/register` | `handleRegister` | Benchmark-compatible session registration |
| POST | `/evaluate` | `handleEvaluate` | PreToolUse — full judge pipeline, deny/allow, hijack strike tracking |
| POST | `/track` | `handleTrack` | PostToolUse — records file reads/writes, env vars |
| POST | `/end` | `handleEnd` | Stop — logs summary, cleans up session |
| POST | `/pivot` | `handlePivot` | Explicit direction change — resets interceptor |
| POST | `/compact` | `handleCompact` | Context compaction notification |
| POST | `/api/mode` | inline | Runtime `TrustMode` toggle (cross-origin from dashboard) |
| GET | `/api/feed` | inline | Live event ring buffer (cross-origin from dashboard) |
| GET | `/api/health`, `/health` | inline | Version + config status |
| GET | `/api/whoami` | inline | OIDC header debug |
| GET | `/api/data-status` | inline | EFS mount probe |
| GET | `/session/:id` | `handleSessionGet` | Debug — live session context |
| GET | `/` | inline | HTML status landing page |

**Notable logic in `handleEvaluate`:**
- Dual format support: native hook format and benchmark format
- Falls back to policy-only evaluation if no goal is registered
- Session locking after `CONFIG.hijackThreshold` hijack strikes (autonomous mode only)
- `learn` mode is shadow — logs what would be blocked but always allows
- Bench format returns `{verdict, confidence, rationale}` instead of the hook shape

**CORS:** only `/api/feed`, `/api/mode`, and `/api/health` accept cross-origin from `DREDD_DASHBOARD_ORIGIN`.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Judge AI Dredd — Dashboard</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" type="image/x-icon">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0d1117;
      --card: #161b22;
      --border: #30363d;
      --text: #e6edf3;
      --muted: #8b949e;
      --green: #3fb950;
      --red: #f85149;
      --amber: #d29922;
      --blue: #58a6ff;
      --purple: #bc8cff;
    }
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 20px;
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    header h1 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; }
    header h1 span { color: var(--red); }
    .version { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
    .mode-badge {
      padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .mode-interactive { background: var(--amber); color: #000; }
    .mode-autonomous { background: var(--red); color: #fff; }
    .mode-learn { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; }
    .mode-select {
      background: var(--card); color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .mode-select:hover { border-color: var(--muted); }

    .stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .stat {
      background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px;
    }
    .stat-value { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }
    .stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
    .stat-value.green { color: var(--green); }
    .stat-value.red { color: var(--red); }
    .stat-value.amber { color: var(--amber); }
    .stat-value.blue { color: var(--blue); }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    }
    .section-title .count {
      background: var(--border); color: var(--muted);
      padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px;
    }
